Save data

save_data.Rd

Saves R objects as a file with a timestamp in a specified directory

Usage

save_data(
  object,
  file_directory,
  file_name,
  time = c(0, 2359),
  days = 1:7,
  ext = "rds",
  save_function = saveRDS,
  save_function_options = list(),
  run_timestamp = get("run_timestamp", envir = parent.frame()),
  timestamp_file_name = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

R object to save.

file_directory

Character. the location used for saving data.

file_name

Character. (optional) name of the file to save, default = object.

time

Numeric. Valid time range to save file(s) c(START HHMM, END HHMM), example c(0000, 2359). Default = c(0000, 2359)

days

Numeric. Valid days to save, 1 is monday and 7 is sunday, example for mo-fr: 1:5. Default = 1:7

ext

Character. File extention. Default = "rds"

save_function

Function. Optional function to use for saving. First 2 arguments need to be: object, file location. Default = saveRDS.

save_function_options

Character. Optional parameters for the save_function.

run_timestamp

Character. YYYYMMDD_HHMM timestamp of the run.

timestamp_file_name

Boolean. TRUE/FALSE do you want a timestamp in the file_name. Default = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
save_data(
  object = cars,
  file_directory = "output/objects",
  file_name = "cars",
  run_timestamp = "19000101_0000"
)
} # }
